description.html: Dubia roaches (Blaptica dubia), medium size (M), pack of 100 pieces. Dubia roaches are one of the best live food options for reptiles - they are high in protein (about 22%), low in fat (about 7%) and have an excellent calcium-to-phosphorus ratio. The medium size is ideal for adult leopard geckos, young bearded dragons, smaller snakes and other medium-sized reptiles.

Dubia roaches have a softer exoskeleton that is easier to digest than superworms. They do not climb smooth surfaces and do not produce an unpleasant smell, which makes them practical to keep at home. Keep them at room temperature with access to food (fruit, vegetables) for gut-loading before feeding.
